title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Agreement Schedule of Interest Method, Charges and Statements
content:
### Schedule to the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan agreement

This schedule states, for each tier of the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan, how interest accrues, the days in the year used for the daily rate, how installment and interest amounts are rounded, the charges that may arise (penalty for paying early, late fee on a missed installment, fee on a returned direct ACH payment) and how often statements are issued.

| Item | Paystride Payroll Loan 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 and 5000 (identical in all six tiers) |
|---|---|
| How interest accrues | simple interest on the unpaid principal, accrued daily |
| Days in the year for the daily rate | 365 |
| Rounding of installment and interest amounts | to the nearest cent; the final installment absorbs any difference |
| Penalty for paying early | $0.00 |
| Late fee on a missed installment | $0.00 |
| Fee on a returned direct ACH payment | $0.00 |
| Statements | monthly |

### Notes to the schedule

1. **Daily rate.** Because the year counts 365 days, the daily rate is the tier's fixed APR divided over 365 days. For a hypothetical APR of 17.99%, the daily rate is about 0.0493% of the unpaid principal.
2. **Simple, not compounding.** Interest is figured on the unpaid principal only; interest already accrued is not itself part of the principal on which interest is figured.
3. **Charges.** The penalty for paying early, the late fee and the returned-payment fee are each $0.00 in every tier.
4. **Rounding.** Installment and interest amounts are rounded to the nearest cent, and the final installment absorbs any difference. Hypothetical illustration: if a hypothetical amount of $1000.00 were repaid in three installments and each of the first two rounded to $333.33, the final installment would be $333.34, absorbing the remaining cent.
5. **Statements.** Statements are issued monthly.
